reviews.author: Marc McCormick
reviews.text: Rajesh and the Equitable team went above and beyond for my client and myself. I'm definitely including Rajesh in my front line go-to lenders now.

reviews.author: Jennifer M
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience with Equitable Lending & I especially want to recognize Rajesh Bhavnani for his professionalism, knowledge, and speed. He made the entire process smooth and easy and they closed my DSCR loan in 2 weeks! He took the time to answer all of my questions, the loan terms offered were exactly what he quoted upfront and he was able to schedule a rush appraisal very quickly. His processing team, Anthony and Carolina were very professional and as a real estate investor who has done many loans I can say this was the best loan team I’ve worked with. I highly recommend Rajesh and the team at Equitable Lending to anyone looking for a trustworthy & knowledgeable lending professional!

reviews.author: Ty Upshaw
reviews.text:
I came across a profile on Zillow that was just full of five star ratings on this one broker named Ragesh Bhavnani.  And here I am now wishing I could give him 10 stars!  Ragesh simply sets the bar sky high for the industry to say the least. I've been in the realestate business for maybe 20yrs on and off,  I've  had a plethora of mortgage brokers close deals for me,  none even come close to the  meticulous attention and expert guidance I got from Ragesh.
Listen people, I would call Ragesh after hours and he would answer every single time!  He got me approved for a VA construction loan to build my dream home in Georgia.   Rajesh took me under his wing and guided me through to the closing table,  and let me tell you,  there were major hurdles along the way and the man never even blinked!!! I'm talking Clint Eastwood cool here folks!,,, he's confident and he's an expert.,,period.  Glad we met my friend, now lets do another new construction deal!!

reviews.author: Astrid Sanchez
reviews.text: Rajesh and his team are very thorough and patient. Rajesh took the time to explain everything in detail. No matter what question I had, he responded quickly. I appreciated the process.

reviews.author: Iris Property Ventures LLC
reviews.text: Raj and Adrian at Equitable Lending are absolutely incredible! Their speed, responsiveness, and attention to detail blew me away!  I’ve never worked with a team so on top of everything. From start to finish, they made the loan process smooth, effortless, and stress-free, and I always felt completely supported. The fastest close I’ve ever experienced! They are truly the best company I’ve ever come across, and I will always work with Equitable Lending for every property I purchase. If you want a team that delivers results quickly, professionally, and with unmatched care, Raj and Adrian are simply the best!

reviews.author: Sarah Dunbar-Riley
reviews.text:
I cannot say enough about our lender, Rajesh Bhavnani . He is truly outstanding and amazing All in One! Rajesh is extremely communicative, always ready to speak with you, and consistently gets back to you almost instantly. He’s always available to go back and forth, run numbers, and provide valuable suggestions.

Moreover, Rajesh truly takes into account the needs of your family, assisting you where you are and helping you get to where you need to be to purchase your home. I truly believe that without Rajesh’s guidance, I would not be purchasing right now. The process can be very overwhelming, but Rajesh simplified it and made it feel feasible, and I never felt alone at any part of the way.

I look forward to purchasing any future homes with Rajesh and know we’ll always be in the best hands. For Rajesh, it’s not just about the purchase; it’s about ensuring the home or property is the best fit for your needs and that your financials support what’s required.

I would recommend him a million percent to anyone in need of a lender! Thank you so Much Rajesh and Equitable Lending for Making a home buying dream into a reality!

Thank you so much again,
Sarah Dunbar-Riley
